question: Can a deterministic finite-crystal stack produce an energy-conserving, layer-order-sensitive exposure-capture mechanism with within-footprint detail loss that independent additive or point-capture grain controls cannot reproduce?

source_basis.title: Photographic grain
source_basis.role: latest production description of finite crystal footprints, layer filling and remaining-light depletion

source_basis.title: Stochastic photographic grain synthesis from crystallographic structure simulation
source_basis.role: public engineering hypothesis and equations; not treated as peer-reviewed physical validation

source_basis.title: Film grain synthesis technology for video applications
source_basis.role: current additive frequency/AR engineering baseline family, not an emulsion-physics authority

mechanism.overlap_resolution: nearest normalized crystal centre; canonical crystal id breaks exact ties
mechanism.footprint_capture: capture_efficiency times the minimum of mean remaining exposure over each finite footprint and local remaining exposure
mechanism.remaining_light: next layer receives previous remaining exposure exactly

controls.point_capture_depletion: same crystal maps and remaining-light recursion, but each covered pixel captures its own exposure without footprint averaging
controls.no_depletion_footprint: same crystal maps and footprint averages, but every layer rereads original exposure and sums independently
controls.reverse_layer_order: same exact crystal maps applied bottom-to-top

branch_rule.pass: Retain the layered finite-crystal capture/depletion mechanism and open a separately frozen exposure-to-developed-structure synthetic compiler comparison before photographs.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact crystal geometry and capture rule without changing layers, geometry, efficiency, fixtures or gates; use H.274/H.Sup21 frequency/AR synthesis only as an engineering control, not a physical rescue.

forbidden: claim microscopic crystal dimensions, stock calibration or measured emulsion truth
copy Ansel or article source code
renormalize realized fields or globally compensate brightness
change crystal geometry, capture efficiency, fixtures or gates after scoring
apply additive display-RGB grain or generate final RGB with a learned model
run photographic or product evaluation before a separate typed compiler gate
claim_ceiling: Clean-room synthetic mechanism evidence for finite crystal footprints and layerwise remaining-light depletion in relative layer exposure; not peer-reviewed validation, microscopic calibration, developed dye-cloud or silver geometry, stock response, photographic quality or product evidence.
